info.name: School ERP API
info.description:
School ERP Backend — all REST APIs (Auth, Students, Fees, Payments, Scholarships, Reports, etc.).

Setup:
1. Import `Local.postman_environment.json`
2. Set `baseUrl` (default http://localhost:8080)
3. Run **01 - Auth > Public > Login** — saves `token` and `userId`
4. Other requests inherit Bearer {{token}} from collection auth
